CalSwipes Support

Get help with questions, bugs, or problems with the app.

Need help?

For questions, bugs, or problems with CalSwipes, email us at support.calswipes@gmail.com.

Common issues

Menus aren't loading

Make sure your iPhone has an internet connection and try reopening CalSwipes.

The nearest dining hall is incorrect

CalSwipes uses your device's location while the app is in use to automatically select the nearest Berkeley dining hall.

My nutrition information is incorrect

Please verify the food's information and contact support if you believe there is an error.

I found a bug

Email support.calswipes@gmail.com with a description of the problem and, if possible, the steps that caused it.
